tasks.title: Build a Sentence
Damaged Furniture
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You recently purchased a piece of furniture for your dorm room from an online store called 'Home Comforts.' When the item arrived, you discovered that it was damaged during shipping. You are disappointed because you were looking forward to using the new furniture. You need to contact customer service to resolve the issue.
bullets: Describe the item you purchased and the damage it sustained.
Explain why you are disappointed with the situation.
Request a replacement or a refund for the damaged item.
tasks.subject: Furniture Delivery Problem
tasks.sample:
Dear Ms. Brown,

I am writing about a wooden desk I purchased from Home Comforts for my dorm room. When the package arrived yesterday, one of the legs was cracked and the surface had a long scratch, so I cannot assemble or use the desk safely.

I am disappointed because I chose this desk specifically for evening study and had already moved my old table out of the room. I checked the packing list and all parts were included, so the damage appears to have occurred during shipping rather than because of a missing piece.

Could you please arrange a replacement of the same model, or a full refund if a replacement is not available this week? I can send photographs, the order number, and the damaged parts. I would appreciate instructions for return shipping at no additional cost.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]
tasks.analysis: 邮件需覆盖三点：所购物品与损坏、失望原因、要求换货或退款。称呼 Ms. Brown。

tasks.title: Brand Loyalty vs New Customers
tasks.instruction: Write a discussion response. An effective response contains at least 100 words.

professor.name: Dr. Gupta
professor.text: Next week, we will be discussing the impact of brand loyalty on consumer behavior. Brand loyalty refers to consumers purchasing products from the same brand repeatedly. Some marketers argue that building brand loyalty is essential for long-term success, while others believe that attracting new customers should be the priority. What do you think is more important for a company, building brand loyalty or attracting new customers?

posts.name: Claire
posts.text: Building brand loyalty is important for long-term success. Loyal customers provide consistent revenue and often become brand advocates, attracting new customers through word-of-mouth recommendations.

posts.name: Paul
posts.text: Attracting new customers can lead to increased market share and growth opportunities. Focusing on new customers can also diversify the revenue streams for the company.

tasks.sample: I believe building brand loyalty is more important than constantly chasing new customers, though the two are connected. Claire is right that loyal buyers provide steady revenue and recommend the brand to others, which is a cheaper form of growth than paid advertising. A coffee shop that remembers regulars and keeps quality consistent will fill seats even in a slow month. Paul is correct that new customers expand market share, but a company that wins people once and then loses them spends more on acquisition than it earns. In my view, a firm should first make current customers want to stay, then use that reputation to attract newcomers. Loyalty creates the advocates Paul hopes new marketing will find.
tasks.analysis: 需在品牌忠诚与拉新之间表态，并回应 Claire、Paul。较好答法：忠诚带来稳定收入与口碑，拉新建立在留存之上。
